title: KILN ROADMAP.md structured head
trace: P-VI (Gate 0 = sole admission, human-only, always), P-VII (recorded), P-IX (roadmap fields)
description: The deliverable's firing program. The structured head is the source of truth; the rendered table is a projection (M4). RULE M3: a shipped/empty artifact has gate0.status=pending and NO committed ordering; an approved gate0 or committed ordering is rejected by this schema's 'roadmap-state' guard so the scaffold cannot pre-authorize a program (Q2=A).

rows.description: Empty array for the shipped artifact (Q2=A).

ordering.description: Firing order; references only existing row ids (M1). Unset/empty = not-yet-committed.

allOf.$comment: M3: a SHIPPED / empty artifact must not pre-authorize a program. If gate0 is approved OR ordering is committed, the artifact must also carry a human-decided gate0 record. The scaffold ships status=pending + empty ordering, which PASSES. A committed program is produced only by Gate 0 (a human move), checked in the negative suite.

row.title: RoadmapRow (one row = one full Gates 1..9 lane)

deps.description: Cycle-free references to existing row ids (M1). A row is eligible to fire iff all deps are 'done' (M2).

gate.description: Present IFF status=active: the in-flight row's live Gate 1..9 (G1: distinct from gate0).
